pace_note: shots 1 (7.6 to 13.0 s) and 3 (16.9 to 21.3 s) each span two or three of the teaser's own cuts (dark corridor, the red N7 stripe, the helmet); one continuous stretch of the official teaser
speech_ok: not speech: faster-whisper hallucination on the compressed score ('ДИНАМИЧНАЯ МУЗЫКА', Russian for 'dynamic music'); the same stretch before compression transcribed as no speech, and VAD finds no voice in the teaser
